families.name: leading optional on an empty graph

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n) RETURN n
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) RETURN n, n.name
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:LeadingSource)-[r:LeadingLink]->(b:LeadingTarget) RETURN a, r, b
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (a:LeadingSource)-[:LeadingLink]->(b:LeadingTarget) RETURN p
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:LeadingSource)-[:LeadingLink*1..2]->(b:LeadingTarget) RETURN a, b
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:LeadingSource)-[:LeadingLink*0..0]->(b:LeadingSource) RETURN a, b
OPTIONAL MATCH (n) RETURN count(*), count(n), collect(n)
OPTIONAL MATCH (a:LeadingSource) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[r:LeadingLink]->(b:LeadingTarget) RETURN a, r, b
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) UNWIND [7,7] AS x RETURN n, x
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) WITH n AS item RETURN item, coalesce(item.name, 'missing')
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) WITH 7 AS x RETURN x
MATCH (n:LeadingSource) RETURN n
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) CREATE (c:LeadingTarget {role:'created', source:coalesce(n.name, 'missing')})
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) CREATE (c:LeadingTarget {role:'created', source:coalesce(n.name, 'missing')}) RETURN c.source

variants.name: empty graph null update then create without return

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) SET n.seen = true WITH n CREATE (c:LeadingTarget {role:'created', source:coalesce(n.name, 'missing')})

variants.name: empty graph null update then create with return

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) SET n.seen = true WITH n CREATE (c:LeadingTarget {role:'created', source:coalesce(n.name, 'missing')}) RETURN c.source

variants.name: null row feeds with alias property

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) WITH n AS item RETURN item, item.name

variants.name: unwind rows feed optional with alias

vars.query: UNWIND [1,1] AS x OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) WITH x, n AS item RETURN x, item.name

variants.name: with row feeds optional with alias

vars.query: WITH 1 AS x OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) WITH x, n AS item RETURN x, item.name

variants.name: with and unwind rows feed optional with alias

vars.query: WITH 1 AS x UNWIND [2,2] AS y OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingSource) WITH x, y, n AS item RETURN x, y, item.name

variants.name: matching nodes without extra null row

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.name IN ['one','two'] RETURN n.name
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.name = 'absent' RETURN n, n.name
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.name = $name RETURN n
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget {name:'absent'}) RETURN n
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget) WHERE false RETURN n
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.missing = 1 RETURN n

variants.name: matching relationships without extra null row

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'eligible' AND r.enabled = true RETURN s.name, r.enabled, n.name
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'absent' AND r.enabled = true RETURN s, r, n
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget)<-[r:LeadingLink]-(s:LeadingSource {name:'source'}) WHERE n.role = 'absent' RETURN s, r, n
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]-(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'absent' RETURN s, r, n

variants.name: all comma separated bindings are null

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'}), (n:LeadingTarget {name:'absent'}) RETURN s, n
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'}), (n:LeadingTarget {name:'one'}) RETURN s.name, n.name
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[:LeadingLink*1..2]->(n:LeadingTarget {name:'absent'}) RETURN s, n
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[:LeadingLink*0..0]->(n:LeadingSource) RETURN s.name, n.name
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (s:LeadingSource {name:'absent'})-[:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) RETURN p
OPTIONAL MATCH p = (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget {name:'one'}) RETURN length(p)
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'absent'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) RETURN *

variants.name: chained optional preserves failed leading row

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'absent' AND r.enabled = true OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:LeadingOtherLink]->(m:LeadingTarget) RETURN s, n, m

variants.name: independent optional can match after leading failure

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget {name:'absent'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'}) RETURN n, s.name

variants.name: mandatory independent match consumes null row

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget {name:'absent'}) MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'}) RETURN n, s.name
OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget {name:'absent'}) WITH n WHERE n IS NOT NULL RETURN n

variants.name: distinct null and aggregate row counts

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (n:LeadingTarget {name:'absent'}) WITH DISTINCT n RETURN count(*), count(n)

variants.name: rejected pattern predicate retains null row

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource) WHERE (s)-[:LeadingOtherLink]->(:LeadingDecoy) RETURN s
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource) WHERE (s)-[:LeadingOtherLink]->(:LeadingTarget) RETURN s.name
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource) WHERE NOT (s)-[:LeadingLink]->(:LeadingTarget) RETURN s.name
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'eligible' AND r.enabled = true SET n.seen = true, r.seen = true RETURN n.name

OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'eligible' AND r.enabled = true CREATE (c:LeadingTarget {role:'created', source:coalesce(n.name, 'missing')}) RETURN c.source

variants.name: set then create matched with return

vars.query: OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'eligible' AND r.enabled = true SET n.seen = true WITH n CREATE (c:LeadingTarget {role:'created', source:coalesce(n.name, 'missing')}) RETURN c.source
OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'eligible' AND r.enabled = true SET n.seen = true, r.seen = true

OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'eligible' AND r.enabled = true CREATE (c:LeadingTarget {role:'created', source:coalesce(n.name, 'missing')})

OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'absent' AND r.enabled = true SET n.seen = true, r.seen = true RETURN n.name

OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'absent' AND r.enabled = true CREATE (c:LeadingTarget {role:'created', source:coalesce(n.name, 'missing')}) RETURN c.source

OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'absent' AND r.enabled = true SET n.seen = true, r.seen = true

OPTIONAL MATCH (s:LeadingSource {name:'source'})-[r:LeadingLink]->(n:LeadingTarget) WHERE n.role = 'absent' AND r.enabled = true CREATE (c:LeadingTarget {role:'created', source:coalesce(n.name, 'missing')})
